name: PaXini
summary:
PaXini develops tactile sensing, dexterous hands and humanoid robotics as a connected embodied-intelligence stack. Founded in 2021, the company builds multidimensional sensing technology intended to give robots more information about contact and physical interaction. Its portfolio includes tactile sensors, DexH hands and the TORA-ONE humanoid platform.

The company also develops data-collection infrastructure and OmniVTLA models combining vision, touch, language and action. Its role spans supplying components to other robot developers and building complete systems. Target applications include precision manufacturing, automotive production and care-related environments, where reliable manipulation depends on understanding how objects respond to contact.
